audit.sourceNotes: 125 complete historical UEFA games; match neutral grounds not exhaustively verified. 2020-21 UCL participation verified for UEFA Technical Observer list and selected Chelsea official, Porto FBref, Gladbach FBref individual statistics; other nominees remain provisional unverified.; 2018/19 and 2019/20 domestic archive candidates matched by person name (possible transfers, incomplete club coverage), NOT independently verified.
audit.playerNominationNotes: League snapshots are CONTEXT only, not UCL match appearance proof; Porto manual 2020-21 UCL roster and Gladbach prior-season roster need individual verification. Tiers are conditional hypotheses, not verified UEFA performances.
audit.provisionalGradeReview: UEFA performance overrides applied to selected players, most grades remain domestic-context proxies; do not treat grades as complete independent 3-season historical evaluation.
audit.chelseaCorrectedBackup: Olivier Giroud selected over Tammy Abraham for 2020-21 Champions League bench ST after club official 8 UEFA matches and 6 UEFA goals evidence.
audit.statbunkerAppearanceNotes: 2020/21 UCL Statbunker Most Appearances (global, club-specific Atlético and Atalanta) consulted. Some club totals differ from FBref (notably Porto) and need reconciliation before final approval.
inferredNotRegisteredFromStatbunker: leipzig Josep Martínez not located in 2020/21 UCL match appearances
